cited.quote: we will prioritise the promises made in the election manifesto and implement them in stages

rationale: C1 and C3 speak of implementing manifesto promises, but none shows a GO or other official step forming a state level executive committee for this purpose. C2 and C4 are unrelated committees. Not started.
No extract concerns live telecast of the Legislative Assembly. C1 is about screening government films and videos; C2 to C5 are unrelated.

cited.quote: Planting suitable tree species as road avenues and tree parks will be promoted by the Forest department

rationale: Extracts show general tree-planting schemes (C1 AGAMT-II, C4/C5 Green Tamil Nadu Mission, C2 forest policy) but none concerns planting along the specific route or path in the promise. Related activity only.
No extract shows a monthly CM review with a press report card. C2 mentions CM monitoring of petition disposal and C1 press facilities, but neither is this commitment.

cited.quote: 12 new Primary Schools will be opened and 22 Schools will be upgraded

rationale: C3 plans new primary schools in hilly and remote areas generally, a plan not targeted at fishermen areas and not an official step. C1, C2 are fisheries notes without schools; C4, C5 do not show new schools. Not started.

cited.quote: All unpaved earthen roads in urban areas to be upgraded as all weather paved roads

rationale: C1 sets out urban infrastructure goals in a policy note (plans only). C5 is a Finance Commission grant release and C2 describes existing sanitation schemes; none is a specific official step for the promised better basic facilities. Promise is vague.

cited.quote: To enhance the application of Information and Communication Technology in Agriculture and to disseminate location specific farm information to farmers

rationale: C4 is an agriculture budget list of targets (intent only). C1 and C3 sanction nano technology research at the university, and C2 sets award guidelines for farmer innovators; none is guidelines introducing IT and biotechnology in farming.

cited.quote: disbursing the cash component of the back ended subsidy through ECS

rationale: C3 and C5 describe routine RKVY back-ended subsidies for inputs and seed; they are not incentives tied to adopting information technology or biotechnology. C1, C2 and C4 are loans, sericulture awards and a data centre policy. No matching step.

cited.quote: coaching centres are being established across the State

rationale: C2 says competitive exam coaching centres are being established across the State, a general statement not specific to women graduates or to every district. C4 and C5 sanction TV coaching classes, a different form. No dated step for the promised centres.

cited.quote: Enhanced targeting with relatively higher subsidy shares for the smaller dwelling units

rationale: C1 and C2 cover handloom weaver electricity, rebate and interest subsidies, not housing. C5 is a housing model for urban poor with different amounts, not weavers at Rs 4 lakh. No step raising weaver housing subsidy.

cited.quote: extending relief assistance of Rs.5,000/- each to marine fishermen families

rationale: C2 shows the lean season allowance still at Rs.5,000 and continuing in 2021-22, with no increase to Rs.6,000. C3 only reports budget provisions. No increase shown.
No extract is about multipurpose hospitals in Nilgiris, Kodaikanal, Yercaud or Yelagiri. C1 covers hospital upgrades in other cities; C2 covers a market complex in Nilgiris.

The promise refers to unspecified matters, and no extract shows a new separate investigation section created for them. C1 and C3 describe existing investigation units and C4 creates a textiles commissionerate, which is unrelated.
No extract concerns equipping district hospitals for heart surgery. C1 to C5 are health insurance hospital empanelment lists and orders for private hospitals, which are a different matter.

cited.quote: Four laning of Vikravandi- Kumbakonam- Thanjavur Road

rationale: C1, a policy note, lists four laning of this road among projects where action will be taken to expedite. This is a statement of intent, not a GO or tender. C2 to C5 concern other roads.

cited.quote: Board has planned to conduct Tamil Nadu Teachers Eligibility Test for the year 2021

rationale: C4 mentions only a planned TNTET and routine recruitment; no order giving jobs to TET passers since 2013. Other extracts are unrelated. Related activity only.

cited.quote: accord adminisirative sanction for a sum of Rs.1355 Crore for unit cost

rationale: C4 sanctions PMAY-G rural houses and C3 reports urban housing programmes, neither targeted to fishermen. C1 and C2 are fisheries schemes without housing. No step for 2 lakh fishermen houses.

cited.quote: The number of 108 ambulances operated will be expanded to 1,303 vehicles

rationale: C3 targets 1,303 ambulances and C1 reports 1,303 in operation, below the promised 2000 with 6 per Panchayat Union. No order expanding to 2000 is shown.

cited.quote: a detailed assessment of all the jewel loans disbursed is required before the waiver is taken up

rationale: C3 (budget speech, 2021-08-13) says the jewel loan waiver is on the agenda but a detailed assessment must precede it. No GO or waiver is shown in other extracts.

cited.quote: will continue to urge the Union Government to declare Tamil, as one of the official languages of India

rationale: C1 records urging the Union on Tamil as an official language, a neighbouring subject. No Assembly resolution, letter or GO on conducting state-level competitive examinations in state languages is shown.
